lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.focus: arc length, radian measure, and sector area derived from similarity
lessonRef.title: Performance task build: arc length, radian measure, and sector area derived from similarity

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Set up the first two carefully; the rest of the build depends on them.

items.prompt: A circle has radius 2. Find the arc length and the sector area for a central angle of 90°, in terms of π.
A quadrilateral is inscribed in a circle. One angle measures 109°. Find the measure of the opposite angle.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: An inscribed angle in a circle intercepts an arc of 52°. Find the measure of the inscribed angle.
A circle has radius 8. From an external point 17 from the centre, a tangent is drawn. Find the length of the tangent segment, and state the fact that makes this possible.
choices: 15, because the tangent bisects the radius
9, because the radius is perpendicular to the tangent at the point of tangency
25, because the tangent extends beyond the circle
15, because the radius is perpendicular to the tangent at the point of tangency

items.prompt: A circle has radius 9. Find the arc length and the sector area for a central angle of 45°, in terms of π.
A quadrilateral is inscribed in a circle. One angle measures 150°. Find the measure of the opposite angle.
An inscribed angle in a circle intercepts an arc of 118°. Find the measure of the inscribed angle.
A circle has radius 7. From an external point 25 from the centre, a tangent is drawn. Find the length of the tangent segment, and state the fact that makes this possible.
choices: 32, because the tangent extends beyond the circle
24, because the radius is perpendicular to the tangent at the point of tangency
18, because the radius is perpendicular to the tangent at the point of tangency
24, because the tangent bisects the radius

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Carry the build to a result and state the check that would catch an error in it.

items.prompt: A circle has radius 8. Find the arc length and the sector area for a central angle of 45°, in terms of π.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
